domain: script glyph parser, 4bpp expander, render-tile allocator and VRAM uploader
semantic_evidence: The retained owner reads a u16 control stream, using commands 3..30 to update or skip parser state and values above 30 as packed glyph identifiers; this is unrelated to the battle success-roll family template.

Resource Value_00000013 supplies packed glyph rows. The candidate expands eight rows into a temporary 0x800-byte buffer using the reference's nibble lookup and bit-spread masks 0x0ff00ff0 and 0x00ff00ff.
The Data_03001e8c render state fields at 0xea0, 0xea2, 0xea7 and 0xeae control tile allocation, palette-bank selection, and the 128-versus-256-slot mask. Occupancy bytes begin at render state +0xda0.
Each allocated tile copies eight words from row planes spaced 0x100 bytes apart into VRAM at 0x06000000 + tile_index*32, then publishes the same encoded tile value through both output streams.
The 0x03000164 clear and 0x03000168 fill routines are genuine r3-trampoline callees and are modeled as function pointers, not ordinary Func_080072f0 calls with invented signatures.
verdict: Materially advanced from an aggregate-m2c context artifact to a standalone canonical-GCC-compiling semantic draft. It remains 48 bytes long with different topology and claims zero DONE bytes. Remaining work is concentrated in the compiler's 68-byte reference frame/lifetime layout and exact lowering of the irregular command switch and nested glyph loops; adoption requires a fresh differing_halfwords=0.
rejected_evidence: The generated BattleEffect_RollSuccess retarget is a false family match and was not used.

Plain integer resource id 19 and ordinary direct Func_080072f0 calls compile, but lose the retained literal-pool and r3-callee semantics; the evidence-correct Value_00000013 and function-pointer forms are retained even though the broad topology residual masks their local score contribution.
